entities.summary: Tinatin Dalakishvili (b. 1991-02-02, Tbilisi) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Tbilisi and Georgia. Known in the fields of georgia, composers & musicians, asia.
